title: Dimensional Change of Peri implant Soft Tissue Following Immediate Implant Placement and Customized Healing Abutment in Posterior Teeth
authors: Choorak N, Amornsettachai P, Chuenjitkuntaworn B, Suphangul S. J Int Dent Med Res. 2021 Jan;14(1), 273-279.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “, IIP with CHA could maintain the architecture and horizontal dimension of “transmucosal tissue” but could not maintain the vertical dimension of lingual height and buccolingual width during the 6-month follow-up” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
